requirements.title: GO TO statement syntax names a target label
requirements.definition: A goto-stmt is the keywords GO TO followed by a label.

pending.go-to-label-form: PENDING positive-control complete source containing GO TO followed by a valid statement label satisfying C1174.
pending.label-token-required: PENDING source diagnostic/control pair for a missing or malformed label, with the repair changing only the label token and keeping the target valid.

requirements.oracle: Syntax admission only; target validity and execution transfer are owned by C1174 and p1.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This source-only catalogue records pending plans only. It creates no Fortran test program, invokes no processor, approves no fixture or oracle, and claims no coverage. Future fixtures must isolate the cited source unit, use a conforming positive control when a diagnostic is expected, and observe control transfer by which statement executes next rather than by assumed branch implementation, compiler wording, process status, or agreement with another processor.
requirements.dependencies: 6.4 labels registered;11.2.1 branch target concept and C1174 in this packet.

requirements.title: A GO TO label designates a branch target statement in the same inclusive scope
requirements.definition: The label in a GO TO statement shall be the statement label of a branch target statement that appears in the same inclusive scope as the goto-stmt.

pending.go-to-valid-target-control: PENDING positive-control GO TO to a labeled branch target statement in the same inclusive scope, with distinct fallthrough and target sentinels.
pending.go-to-nonbranch-target-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control pair where the only differing property is that the label is attached to a statement kind not in the 11.2.1 branch-target list; repair moves the same label to an otherwise equivalent branch target statement.
pending.go-to-target-outside-inclusive-scope-rej: PENDING diagnostic/control pair where the only differing property is that the labeled branch target appears outside the GO TO statement's inclusive scope; repair places an otherwise identical target in the same inclusive scope.

requirements.oracle: Each negative is attributed solely to C1174: target statement kind or same-inclusive-scope relation. The control must satisfy R1159 and execute neither unrelated construct exits nor alternate-return/I/O branches.

requirements.title: Executing GO TO branches to the statement identified by its label
requirements.definition: Execution of a GO TO statement causes a branch to the branch target statement identified by the label.

pending.go-to-transfers-to-labeled-target: PENDING runtime plan with separate pre-GO-TO, fallthrough, target, and after-target sentinels showing the labeled target is the next executed statement.
pending.go-to-skips-fallthrough: PENDING runtime plan proving the intervening fallthrough statement was not executed, without assuming anything about generated code or using an intrinsic that duplicates branch semantics.

requirements.oracle: The observable effect is which statement executed next; target legality remains C1174.
